description: Resends or cancels a client invite. Use when a client lost the invite email, the email failed, or the invite should be withdrawn. Not for new invites (use invite_client). Returns the invite ID and new status. resend emails the client again; cancel withdraws a pending invite and can't be undone (invite again instead).

action.description: resend = email the invite again (pending or failed invites); cancel = withdraw a pending invite.

invite_id.description: ID of the invite. Get it from list_client_invites, e.g. "6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: manage_client_invite
title: Resend or cancel client invite
